relationships.subject: TRPM8
relationships.evidence_quote: For example, a TRPM8 agonist could be used in conjunction with cyclosporine to enhance basal tear production while simultaneously suppressing T-cell-mediated inflammation [122,193].

key_findings: Review of TRP, Nav and P2X ion channels as drivers of neuropathic ocular pain in dry eye disease and as therapeutic targets.
